note: Geometry re-conditioned as *future* road topology. The dataset's own G phrases describe the geometry visible right now ('right lane of a two-lane road'), which the conditioning image already fixes -- the pipeline overwrites the first latent frame with that image at every step, so a caption claiming a different lane count contradicts what is on screen and the model cannot honour it. Dynamics escaped this because a single frame cannot say whether the car will accelerate. These pairs give geometry the same escape: road topology that is out of frame and only arrives as the clip plays. Each pair is word-count matched.
